COMMAND.name: ip route

PARAM.name: nexthop
PARAM.help: Next-hop A.B.C.D or egress interface name

COMMAND.ACTION: tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop ${nexthop}

COMMAND.name: ip route distance
COMMAND.help: Add an IPv4 static route with administrative distance

PARAM.name: nexthop
PARAM.help: Next-hop A.B.C.D or egress interface name

COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop ${nexthop}
tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} distance ${distance}

COMMAND.name: no ip route
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate delete-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} distance
tertoos-cli candidate delete-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop

COMMAND.name: ipv6 route

PARAM.name: nexthop
PARAM.help: Next-hop X:X::X or egress interface name

COMMAND.ACTION: tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop ${nexthop}

COMMAND.name: ipv6 route distance
COMMAND.help: Add an IPv6 static route with administrative distance

PARAM.name: nexthop
PARAM.help: Next-hop X:X::X or egress interface name

COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop ${nexthop}
tertoos-cli candidate set-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} distance ${distance}

COMMAND.name: no ipv6 route
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate delete-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} distance
tertoos-cli candidate delete-raw STATIC_ROUTE default|${prefix} nexthop
